Synopsis:
Goldman Sachs senior counsel Kathryn Ruemmler testified before the House Oversight Committee in a closed-door hearing regarding her past ties to Jeffrey Epstein. She denied knowledge of his criminal conduct, expressed regret over the relationship, and characterized him as a "masterful liar." Democrats on the panel publicly stated she was not being forthright. Ruemmler stepped down as Goldman's Chief Legal Officer in late June following DOJ document releases revealing extensive communications with and gift acceptance from Epstein. Goldman has faced institutional and political pressure over its decision to retain her in an advisory capacity during the transition.
